summary.text: Steven Winter was elected in November 2024 to represent Connecticut's 94th Assembly District, which covers New Haven and Hamden, in the state House of Representatives.

paragraphs.text: He served on the New Haven Board of Alders from 2018 through 2022.
He grew up in Rhode Island, graduated from Yale University and lives in New Haven.
According to the page, he founded an employee-owned software company focused on public information about the electricity grid and is New Haven's Executive Director of Climate and Sustainability.
